messages:
elaine (pm): Quick sync — we need a final decision on which API status classes are launch blockers vs. soft-fail for chat/completions, embeddings, rerank, and function calls. I sketched a proposal below; want alignment before we lock launch gates.

elainE (note typo fix): sorry -> 'elaine'

david (ml): +1, we should be strict about validation/contract errors but allow graceful degradation for model-unavailable. Customers care more about predictable semantics than raw availability.

jin (eng): Agreed. Draft decision matrix: 1) Validation (400) = hard-block (client fix). 2) Auth/Permission (401/403) = hard-block. 3) Rate limit (429) = soft-block for hosted, hard-block for Dedicated? Need to decide. 4) Model unavailable (503) = soft-fail with fallback if possible.

sam (prodops): For Dedicated customers we promised isolation and capacity guarantees — 429 should be surfaced as a capacity alert and not silently degrade. So treat 429 as a launch-block for Dedicated SLAs but soft for hosted free tier w/ queued retries.

elaine (pm): Proposal (compact):
```text
- 4xx (schema/validation/auth) => BLOCK (no launch)
- 429 (rate limit) => BLOCK for Dedicated SLA; SOFT for hosted with backoff + 503 fallback
- 503 (model unavailable) => SOFT, auto-fallback to compatible model variant + instrumented metric
- 502/504 (upstream infra) => SOFT with retry policy and circuit-breaker
- 422 (semantic validation) => SOFT but surfaced in evals as quality regression
```

david (ml): Important: "compatible model variant" must be constrained by quality delta. We should only auto-fallback if expected perplexity delta < threshold. I'll add a short classifier for that.

jin (eng): Implementation notes: will need a routing policy table and per-route flags (block_on_429, fallback_priority). Example config snippet: 
```json
{"route":"chat.v1","block_on_429":false,"fallbacks":["chat-small-v1","chat-stable-alpha"]}
```
We can store this in config service and expose via Console.

sam (prodops): Observability requirements for launch: per-route counters for each status, 95th percentile latency by status, and alert when 429 rate > 0.5% of requests over 5m for Dedicated customers.

ops-bot: NOTE: Incident policy linked -> <https://wiki/redwood/incidents#rate-limits>

david (ml): One more thing — embeddings workloads are very sensitive to silent degradation. For embeddings: 503 => BLOCK for launch (can't silently change vector distribution). We should require explicit fallback validation.

elaine (pm): OK action items: 
- david: define quality delta threshold & embedding validation checklist (due EOW)
- jin: add per-route flags and config schema PR (due Tue)
- sam: define Dedicated 429 alert thresholds and include in SLA doc (due Thu)
- me: update the launch checklist and gate doc with these rules and call out exception process

elaine (pm): Quick vote: do we accept the matrix above as the launch gating baseline? Reply with :thumbsup: to agree, :thumbsdown: to request discussion.

david (ml): :thumbsup:

jin (eng): :thumbsup: (one minor caveat in PR)

sam (prodops): :thumbsup:

elaine (pm): Great — I'll record this in the launch gates doc and ping legal for SLA language. If anything substantial pops up, we'll re-open this thread. Thanks all.
